scientific_interpretation.reason_mean_matching_worsened_rank: The consumed truth residual is positively skewed in the lower conditional-mean quartiles. Its conditional mean lies above its conditional median, so shifting a symmetric Gaussian to the truth mean overshoots the median required for uniform ranks.
scientific_interpretation.Gaussian_family_finding: Neither stationary Gaussian, conditional-scale Gaussian, nor conditional-location-scale Gaussian can reproduce conditional residual ranks even under LOO consumed fitting.
scientific_interpretation.spatial_model_finding: V82A already showed V72 spatial transport is useful and far better than the independent-marginal control in high-k power. Do not discard it.
scientific_interpretation.next_model_class: A conditional non-Gaussian residual flow or equivalent monotone conditional distribution model composed with the existing spatial transport.
hard_constraints: preserve or explicitly condition on coarse/low-k structure
continuous conditional environment rather than four hard deployment bins
proper likelihood, flow-matching, or score objective only
multiscale rank, coverage, P(k), PDF, tail, 2pCF, and morphology used as gates rather than heuristic training losses
